name: recovery-guardian
description: Direct recovery controller with standing-authority preservation, anti-loop repair, regression-first diagnosis, safe rollback, continuous hygiene, and proportional durable evidence.

interface.shortDescription: Recovers interrupted project workflows and prevents duplicate retries.
interface.longDescription: Use Recovery Guardian after failed, interrupted, looping, stale-wait, or ambiguous execution. It reconstructs minimum durable state, verifies writes before retry, directly repairs covered E1 failures under existing standing-authority, changes strategy instead of blind retry, prioritizes regressions and safe rollback, and escalates only at material boundaries or genuine Human Gates.
